verses.en: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:
verses.pt: Quando te assentares a comer com um governador, atenta bem para aquele que está diante de ti;
verses.en_web: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;
verses.en_bbe: When you take your seat at the feast with a ruler, give thought with care to what is before you;

verses.en: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
verses.pt: e põe uma faca à tua garganta, se fores homem de grande apetite.
verses.en_web: put a knife to your throat, if you are a man given to appetite.
verses.en_bbe: And put a knife to your throat, if you have a strong desire for food.

verses.en: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
verses.pt: Não cobices os seus manjares gostosos, porque é comida enganadora.
verses.en_web: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.
verses.en_bbe: Have no desire for his delicate food, for it is the bread of deceit.

verses.en: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
verses.pt: Não te fatigues para seres rico; dá de mão à tua própria sabedoria:
verses.en_web: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
verses.en_bbe: Take no care to get wealth; let there be an end to your desire for money.

verses.en: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
verses.pt: Fitando tu os olhos nas riquezas, elas se vão; pois fazem para si asas, como a águia, voam para o céu.
verses.en_web: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
verses.en_bbe: Are your eyes lifted up to it? it is gone: for wealth takes to itself wings, like an eagle in flight up to heaven.

verses.en: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
verses.pt: Não comas o pão do avarento, nem cobices os seus manjares gostosos.
verses.en_web: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies:
verses.en_bbe: Do not take the food of him who has an evil eye, or have any desire for his delicate meat:

verses.en: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
verses.pt: Porque, como ele pensa consigo mesmo, assim é; ele te diz: Come e bebe; mas o seu coração não está contigo.
verses.en_web: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
verses.en_bbe: For as the thoughts of his heart are, so is he: Take food and drink, he says to you; but his heart is not with you.

verses.en: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
verses.pt: Vomitarás o bocado que comeste, e perderás as tuas suaves palavras.
verses.en_web: The morsel which you have eaten you shall vomit up, and lose your good words.
verses.en_bbe: The food which you have taken will come up again, and your pleasing words will be wasted.

verses.en: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
verses.pt: Não fales aos ouvidos do tolo; porque desprezará a sabedoria das tuas palavras.
verses.en_web: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
verses.en_bbe: Say nothing in the hearing of a foolish man, for he will put no value on the wisdom of your words.

verses.en: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
verses.pt: Não removas os limites antigos; nem entres nos campos dos órfãos,
verses.en_web: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless:
verses.en_bbe: Do not let the landmark of the widow be moved, and do not go into the fields of those who have no father;

verses.en: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.
verses.pt: porque o seu redentor é forte; ele lhes pleiteará a causa contra ti.
verses.en_web: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
verses.en_bbe: For their saviour is strong, and he will take up their cause against you.

verses.en: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.pt: Aplica o teu coração à instrução, e os teus ouvidos às palavras do conhecimento.
verses.en_web: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: Give your heart to teaching, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

verses.en: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
verses.pt: Não retires da criança a disciplina; porque, fustigando-a tu com a vara, nem por isso morrerá.
verses.en_web: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.
verses.en_bbe: Do not keep back training from the child: for even if you give him blows with the rod, it will not be death to him.

verses.en: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
verses.pt: Tu a fustigarás com a vara e livrarás a sua alma do Seol.
verses.en_web: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.
verses.en_bbe: Give him blows with the rod, and keep his soul safe from the underworld.

verses.en: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
verses.pt: Filho meu, se o teu coração for sábio, alegrar-se-á o meu coração, sim, ó, meu próprio;
verses.en_web: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine:
verses.en_bbe: My son, if your heart becomes wise, I, even I, will be glad in heart;

verses.en: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.
verses.pt: e exultará o meu coração, quando os teus lábios falarem coisas retas.
verses.en_web: yes, my heart will rejoice, when your lips speak what is right.
verses.en_bbe: And my thoughts in me will be full of joy when your lips say right things.

verses.en: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the LORD all the day long.
verses.pt: Não tenhas inveja dos pecadores; antes conserva-te no temor do Senhor todo o dia.
verses.en_web: Don’t let your heart envy sinners; but rather fear Yahweh all day long.
verses.en_bbe: Have no envy of sinners in your heart, but keep in the fear of the Lord all through the day;

verses.en: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.pt: Porque deveras terás uma recompensa; não será malograda a tua esperança.
verses.en_web: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
verses.en_bbe: For without doubt there is a future, and your hope will not be cut off.

verses.en: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
verses.pt: Ouve tu, filho meu, e sê sábio; e dirige no caminho o teu coração.
verses.en_web: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, my son, and be wise, guiding your heart in the right way.

verses.en: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
verses.pt: Não estejas entre os beberrões de vinho, nem entre os comilões de carne.
verses.en_web: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat:
verses.en_bbe: Do not be among those who give themselves to wine-drinking, or among those who make themselves full with meat:

verses.en: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
verses.pt: Porque o beberrão e o comilão caem em pobreza; e a sonolência cobrirá de trapos o homem.
verses.en_web: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
verses.en_bbe: For those who take delight in drink and feasting will come to be in need; and through love of sleep a man will be poorly clothed.

verses.en: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.
verses.pt: Ouve a teu pai, que te gerou; e não desprezes a tua mãe, quando ela envelhecer.
verses.en_web: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to your father whose child you are, and do not keep honour from your mother when she is old.

verses.en: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
verses.pt: Compra a verdade, e não a vendas; sim, a sabedoria, a disciplina, e o entendimento.
verses.en_web: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
verses.en_bbe: Get for yourself that which is true, and do not let it go for money; get wisdom and teaching and good sense.

verses.en: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
verses.pt: Grandemente se regozijará o pai do justo; e quem gerar um filho sábio, nele se alegrará.
verses.en_web: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.
verses.en_bbe: The father of the upright man will be glad, and he who has a wise child will have joy because of him.

verses.en: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.
verses.pt: Alegrem-se teu pai e tua mãe, e regozije-se aquela que te deu à luz.
verses.en_web: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!
verses.en_bbe: Let your father and your mother be glad, let her who gave you birth have joy.

verses.en: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
verses.pt: Filho meu, dá-me o teu coração; e deleitem-se os teus olhos nos meus caminhos.
verses.en_web: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.
verses.en_bbe: My son, give me your heart, and let your eyes take delight in my ways.

verses.en: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
verses.pt: Porque cova profunda é a prostituta; e poço estreito é a aventureira.
verses.en_web: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
verses.en_bbe: For a loose woman is a deep hollow, and a strange woman is a narrow water-hole.

verses.en: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.
verses.pt: Também ela, como o salteador, se põe a espreitar; e multiplica entre os homens os prevaricadores.
verses.en_web: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.
verses.en_bbe: Yes, she is waiting secretly like a beast for its food, and deceit by her is increased among men.

verses.en: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?
verses.pt: Para quem são os ais? para quem os pesares? para quem as pelejas, para quem as queixas? para quem as feridas sem causa? e para quem os olhos vermelhos?
verses.en_web: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
verses.en_bbe: Who says, Oh! who says, Ah! who has violent arguments, who has grief, who has wounds without cause, whose eyes are dark?

verses.en: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.
verses.pt: Para os que se demoram perto do vinho, para os que andam buscando bebida misturada.
verses.en_web: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.
verses.en_bbe: Those who are seated late over the wine: those who go looking for mixed wine.

verses.en: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.
verses.pt: Não olhes para o vinho quando se mostra vermelho, quando resplandece no copo e se escoa suavemente.
verses.en_web: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.
verses.en_bbe: Keep your eyes from looking on the wine when it is red, when its colour is bright in the cup, when it goes smoothly down:

verses.en: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
verses.pt: No seu fim morderá como a cobra, e como o basilisco picará.
verses.en_web: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.
verses.en_bbe: In the end, its bite is like that of a snake, its wound like the wound of a poison-snake.

verses.en: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.
verses.pt: Os teus olhos verão coisas estranhas, e tu falarás perversidades.
verses.en_web: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
verses.en_bbe: Your eyes will see strange things, and you will say twisted things.

verses.en: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
verses.pt: o serás como o que se deita no meio do mar, e como o que dorme no topo do mastro.
verses.en_web: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:
verses.en_bbe: Yes, you will be like him who takes his rest on the sea, or on the top of a sail-support.

verses.en: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
verses.pt: E diràs: Espancaram-me, e não me doeu; bateram-me, e não o senti; quando virei a despertar? ainda tornarei a buscá-lo outra vez.
verses.en_web: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I can find another.”
verses.en_bbe: They have overcome me, you will say, and I have no pain; they gave me blows without my feeling them: when will I be awake from my wine? I will go after it again.
